pkgmetadata.longdescription: Platform power defaults for QindaQt laptops, used while QindaQt's native power policy is not exclusive. A short power press suspends and a long press powers off. Closing the lid on battery suspends, then hibernates when the battery runs low or after 90 minutes. User sessions are not frozen during sleep, so FUSE network locations cannot hang suspend. See container-wm ADR-0378.
